title: No UI emits reference_contact_choice, so every real apply-form submission fails validation with an unfixable error until RC1.2 ships
detail: validate_form hard-requires the field, but grep confirms no form_sections/form_fields/form_pages/client code emits it. Deployed without RC1.2, 100% of submissions re-render with an error the applicant cannot fix — apply funnel dead.
recommended_fix: Ship RC1.1 and RC1.2 together, or gate the new validation (feature flag / accept-absent-until-UI) so the form stays submittable before the radio card exists.

title: Grapheme-based string.slice can exceed the codepoint-based CHECK bounds (64/512), 500ing the submission on multi-codepoint headers
evidence:
Ok(#(first, _)) -> string.trim(first) |> string.slice(0, 64)
        Error(_) -> string.trim(value) |> string.slice(0, 64)
...
    Ok(value) -> string.slice(value, 0, 512)
--- supabase/migrations/20260731220100_add_application_capture_columns.sql:
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submitted_ip_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(submitted_ip_text) <= 64),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submitted_user_agent TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(submitted_user_agent) <= 512),
--- the PR's own deferred-work.md entry: "summary: request_helpers.client_ip/client_user_agent slice by graphemes (Gleam string.slice) while the DB CHECK bounds count characters (Postgres length()) — a multi-codepoint header can exceed the bound post-slice and 500 the write path."
detail: Gleam string.slice counts grapheme clusters; Postgres length() counts codepoints. Multi-codepoint graphemes in XFF/UA sliced to 64/512 graphemes can exceed the CHECK, failing the INSERT and 500ing the submission. Tracked in deferred-work.md, unguarded in code.
recommended_fix: Bound by codepoints in request_helpers (post-slice verify codepoint length and re-truncate) across the three callers sharing the 64/512 CHECK idiom.
